description: Address v2 review feedback: fix line-out play_type enum mismatch (backend emits 'line-out' but frontend expects 'lineout') and optimize _check_convergence to use pre-built time indexes instead of O(n) linear scans.
steps: In backend/src/cv/play_detector.py, change play_type='line-out' to play_type='lineout' in both occurrences in _detect_lineouts.
Update _check_convergence to accept pre-built time indexes (dict[float, dict]) instead of raw route lists, using dict lookups and sorted keys with bisect for finding earlier points.
Update the caller in _detect_tackles to pass the time indexes to _check_convergence.
Update backend tests that assert on play_type == 'line-out' to use 'lineout'.
acceptance_criteria: Backend emits play_type='lineout' matching frontend PlayType.LINEOUT = 'lineout'
_check_convergence uses O(1) dict lookups or O(log n) bisect instead of linear scans
All backend tests pass: uv run pytest tests/ -v
Frontend builds and tests pass: npm run build && npm run test -- --run
verification: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v
findings: All 245 backend tests pass. All 35 frontend tests pass. Frontend build succeeds. The lineout enum mismatch fix ensures line-out plays display correctly in the frontend. The _check_convergence optimization uses bisect on pre-sorted keys, reducing per-invocation complexity from O(n) to O(log n) for finding earlier points in the time window.
